items.q: How does the booking process work?
items.a:
• Choose your camper and travel dates
  • We send you a quote
  • Confirm with a 50% deposit

The remaining balance is paid before pickup.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for long rentals?
items.a: Yes! We offer reduced daily rates for longer Patagonia roadtrips of 15 days or more — see the calculator on each camper's page for exact pricing.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept international bank transfers and major credit cards via SumUp. Credit card payments include a 3% processing fee.

items.q: Do I need a security deposit?
items.a: Yes. On the day of delivery, a security deposit of CLP $1,500,000 is required (credit card, transfer, PayPal or cash). It's refunded within 48 hours after the camper is returned in the same condition, with a full tank. For rentals that include travel through Argentina, the security deposit is CLP $2,000,000.

items.q: Where can I pick up the camper?
items.a: Our main hub is Puerto Varas, southern Chile. We can also coordinate pickup or drop-off at Puerto Montt Airport, Coyhaique, or Puerto Natales for an additional fee.

items.q: What are the pickup and return times?
items.a: Pickups are available between 10 AM and 5 PM. Returns must be completed before 4 PM. Every pickup includes a full camper walkthrough.

items.q: Do I need a special driver's license?
items.a: A regular driver's license is enough. You must be at least 25 years old and comfortable driving a manual transmission.

items.q: Can I drive the Carretera Austral with your campers?
items.a: Absolutely. Our 4x4 camper trucks are built for Patagonia roads, gravel sections and remote travel across southern Chile — ideal for a Carretera Austral roadtrip.
Yes. Border crossings into Argentina are allowed with the correct paperwork (arranged with your booking) and the higher CLP $2,000,000 security deposit.

items.q: What is included inside the camper?
items.a:
Each camper rental includes:

  • Bed and bedding
  • Kitchen equipment
  • Fridge and gas stove
  • Outdoor table and chairs
  • Solar power system
  • Diesel heater

items.q: Do you offer internet or Starlink?
items.a: Yes. Optional Starlink rental is available for travelers who need reliable internet in remote Patagonia areas.
Insurance is included with your camper rental in Chile. The deductible is approximately 1,000 EUR.

items.q: What happens if I need help during the trip?
items.a: We provide direct support during your Patagonia trip. If you need route advice, mechanical help or roadside assistance, contact us anytime by WhatsApp.

items.q: Do I need to return the camper clean?
items.a:
Return checklist:

  • Interior & exterior clean (fee up to CLP $150,000 if not)
  • Full fuel tank — missing fuel charged at CLP $2,500/liter
  • Portable toilet emptied and clean (fee up to CLP $300,000 if not)
  • All equipment complete and undamaged per the inventory list
  • Vehicle documents returned to South Nomads Campers
